newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama taxi drivers demand more protection.
newsitem.headline: Panama taxi drivers demand more protection.

text.p: Hundreds of Panamanian taxi drivers clogged city streets on Thursday to demand more police protection and protest about a wave of violent crime directed against them.
"There have been 62 drivers killed in the past seven years. We want justice," taxi driver and activist Marcos Gonzalez told reporters.
Gonzalez said two drivers were killed in the capital in the past week.
National Police Director Jose Sosa said police had made several arrests and were investigating teenage gang members.
"In order to enter the gang, they have to kill someone. Up to now, it has been taxi drivers," Sosa said.
The taxi drivers' caravan, with "justice" painted on the rear windows of their vehicles, drove at a snail's pace to the Attorney General's office to discuss safety measures.
